rationale.conceptual: The paper's method is a standard application of DFT to a molecular cluster, but the task requires choosing an appropriate functional, handling constrained atoms, and correctly setting up transition-state searches—a non-trivial implementation of an established method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves building a cluster model, running multiple DFT geometry optimizations and TS searches (bare cluster, peroxide, two intermediates, three TS), and compiling barriers. This constitutes a multi-stage computational workflow with non-trivial software (DFT code) environment, fitting 4–6 stages.
